subject: DataForge validation: acceptance matrix, owners & sprint kickoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@dataforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-28T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: DataForge validation: acceptance matrix, owners & sprint kickoff

Hi Alyssa — great call today, thanks for walking through the scope. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Acceptance matrix: I attached a lightweight matrix (DataForge_Acceptance_Matrix.xlsx) with the candidate success criteria we sketched on the call. Please review and flag anything missing.

2) Owners: suggested owners in the sheet — we propose Alex (SRE) for latency/load gates, and Priya (NLP lead) for relevance/quality checks. Can you confirm?

3) Timeline: proposed 3-week validation window starting Monday 3/1 with two checkpoints (end of week 1: infra readiness; end of week 3: acceptance decision).

4) Procurement & SOW: Ben, looping you for SOW draft and billing cadence. Tom (procurement) will need a short statement of work and estimated GPU hours.

5) Next call: 30 mins on Monday 3/1 to kickoff and agree on test inputs.

Action items (owners & dates):
- Alyssa: confirm owners & add any success criteria by 3/2 (owner: Alyssa)
- Marissa: finalize kickoff agenda and send meeting invite by 2/28 EOD
- Ben: share SOW draft v1 by 3/3 (owner: Ben)
- Karthik: provide recommended model/config profile and baseline latency targets by 3/1

Attaching: DataForge_Acceptance_Matrix.xlsx (stub), SOW_draft_v1.pdf (stub).

Thanks — looking forward to a quick kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@dataforge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Brooks <t.brooks@dataforge.io>
Date: 2027-03-01T08:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: DataForge validation: acceptance matrix, owners & sprint kickoff

Thanks Marissa — clear summary and appreciated. Quick answers: 

- Owners: confirmed — Alex Martinez (alex.m@dataforge.io) will own infra/sre checks, and Priya Natarajan (priya.n@dataforge.io) will own relevance QA. I'll add them to the matrix and share an updated copy by EOD 3/2.

- Timeline: 3/1 kickoff works. We'll need two sample datasets (short/long) and one noisy stream of user queries. I'll upload those to the shared Drive folder by 3/2.

- Procurement: looping Tom — Tom, can you indicate any constraints on the SOW (billing terms, PO requirements)?

Also, small ask: can Redwood send a recommended load profile (qps/sequence length) so Alex can provision accordingly?

Best,
Alyssa
Director, Platform Engineering — DataForge Labs
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@dataforge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Tom Brooks <t.brooks@dataforge.io>
Date: 2027-03-01T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: DataForge validation: acceptance matrix, owners & sprint kickoff

Thanks all — Ben here. I'll get SOW_draft_v1 over by end of day Wednesday (3/3). A couple of quick procurement notes to streamline: 

- We can do a 3-week pilot engagement with a fixed estimate of GPU hours and a usage true-up at the end. If DataForge prefers a PO-first approach we can accept PO within our standard 30-day term.
- For faster onboarding, we can offer a one-time credit for the first week if the PO/contract needs extra approvals (we'll treat as a commercial concession).

Tom — happy to sync if you have specific billing rules.

I'll attach the SOW PDF once it's ready.

-Ben
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@dataforge.io>
Date: 2027-03-03T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: DataForge validation: acceptance matrix, owners & sprint kickoff

Team — short internal note and public update after Ben's SOW commit: 

Internal (Ben/Karthik): please confirm the recommended model profile for this validation. Karthik, you previously mentioned a quantized 8-bit variant of the rdx-13B for cost/latency tradeoffs — can you confirm the target latencies for the two sample datasets? We want numbers to add to the matrix so Alex can set up the load tests.

Public (Alyssa): we'll put the model profile and latency targets into the matrix today. Also creating a 30-min kickoff calendar invite for 3/1 11:00 PT as discussed — invite sent.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@dataforge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.m@dataforge.io>, Priya Natarajan <priya.n@dataforge.io>, Tom Brooks <t.brooks@dataforge.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-07T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: DataForge validation: acceptance matrix, owners & sprint kickoff

Quick status update after kickoff: 

- Alex and Priya confirmed owners and reviewed the matrix. Alex uploaded infra access details to the Drive link you shared.
- We received the recommended profile from Karthik (rdx-13B 8-bit) and ran a quick baseline. Initial observations attached as notes in the Drive (see link).
- Tom (procurement) confirmed they prefer a short PO; Ben, I'll wait for a one-page SOW stating hours and payment terms. If you can get that to Tom by 3/09 we can cut the PO next week.

Next steps (owners & dates):
- Alyssa: finalize matrix with owners and test datasets (3/8)
- Alex: infra smoke tests complete (3/9)
- Karthik: confirm final config and baseline latency targets in the matrix (3/8)
- Ben: deliver SOW one-pager for PO (3/9)

I'll ping if anything blocks. Appreciate the quick responses — good kickoff.

Alyssa
[Attachments referenced above: DataForge_Acceptance_Matrix.xlsx (stub), SOW_draft_v1.pdf (stub)]
